svg.title: Shorten a Vector, Then Keep Its Signs
svg.desc: Illustrative vector values. Matryoshka representation learning (MRL) keeps the first 512 of 2048 float32 values, reducing vector storage from 8 KB to 2 KB. One-bit quantization keeps the signs of those 512 values in 64 B. The kept example values are positive, negative, positive, and positive.
